hypotheses: the definition on the 1a page: C_1a is the largest constant with max_{-1/2<=t<=1/2} ∫ f(t−x) f(x) dx >= C_1a (∫_{-1/4}^{1/4} f)^2 for every non-negative f, so one admissible f with ∫ f ≠ 0 gives C_1a <= max (f*f) / (∫ f)^2 (read)
for equal steps f*f is piecewise linear between consecutive grid knots, so its maximum over t is attained at a knot (read; stated by the registry and the claimant, relied on by the decider)
